title: Sanitary Tee on Horizontal Waste Lines
description: Installing a standard sanitary tee flat on a horizontal waste line is a common installation mistake that causes frequent blockages and poor flow. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from horizontal to vertical flow. When used horizontally, the short sweep fails to properly direct solid waste down the pipe, leading to splashing, solids buildup, and eventual clogs. To maintain proper flow dynamics and direction on horizontal branch connections, professional plumbers always install a wye with a 1/8 bend or a combination wye fitting, aligned with the code-approved slope.

Sanitary Tee on Horizontal Waste Lines

Installing a standard sanitary tee flat on a horizontal waste line is a common installation mistake that causes frequent blockages and poor flow. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from horizontal to vertical flow. When used horizontally, the short sweep fails to properly direct solid waste down the pipe, leading to splashing, solids buildup, and eventual clogs. To maintain proper flow dynamics and direction on horizontal branch connections, professional plumbers always install a wye with a 1/8 bend or a combination wye fitting, aligned with the code-approved slope.
